_doc: W42: the GAPS of the codomain map — surfaces the palette could reach that no emitter writes yet. The EMITTED half is not here: scripts/check_codomain.py reads it from check_publishing (emitters roster x catalog/publishing.md), so it cannot drift. reach and cost are 1-5 judgements (reach: how many users/tools read the format; cost: work to emit and keep it checked); rank = reach x (6 - cost).

gaps.why: Figma (Tokens Studio), Penpot, Style Dictionary and through it Tailwind/Android/iOS all read it: one file, many consumers
